welcome.title: Welcome to the crew.
welcome.body: Four quick steps and you're on the first tee. Everything except your name can be changed or skipped.

profile.title: Who's playing?
profile.body: This is how your friends will find you and see you on leaderboards.

golf.title: Your game.
golf.body: Optional. A handicap index lets ROUND9 calculate net scores and Stableford points for you.

connect.title: Find your people.
connect.body: Start a crew for your regular group, or join one with an invite link.
connect.invalid: Check the name or link and try again.
connect.inviteInvalid: This invite link is invalid, used or expired. Ask for a new one.

ready.title: You're in. Let's play.
ready.body: Create your first round, invite your crew and start keeping score.
